_comment: Message templates. service_eligible=true means a row may be treated as a non-marketing (service) message ONLY if the CSV 'Message Type' column explicitly says 'service'. Everything else is treated as marketing and needs consent date + source. Placeholders in {braces} are filled from config.json and CSV columns. No opt-out line is added unless you set optout_text in config.json and add {optout} to a template. Nothing is ever invented: a missing required field rejects the row.

appointment_reminder.name: Appointment reminder
appointment_reminder.body: Hi {first_name}, this is a reminder of your appointment with {agent_name} at {business_name} on {appointment_date} at {appointment_time}. Reply to confirm or reschedule.

client_followup.name: Client follow-up
client_followup.body: Hi {first_name}, this is {agent_name} at {business_name}. I wanted to follow up on our recent conversation. Is there a good time this week to talk?

event_invitation.name: Event invitation
event_invitation.body: Hi {first_name}, {business_name} is hosting {event_name} on {event_date}. You're welcome to join. Reply YES if you'd like details.

general.name: General communication (wraps your own Message text)
